notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
New Features:
- Complete Reworked Game Soundtrack: All soundtracks have been completely reworked, remixed & mastered
- Complete new Evolution Soundtrack
- Major Balancing Rework: More initial Attackspeed and more Enemy Spawns
- New unspent skillpoint UI displaying the amount of unspent skillpoints

Balancing:
- Increased initial attackspeed by +50%
- Increased initial enemy spawn rate

Bugfixes:
- Fixed a bug that caused enemy absorb skill to not increase your attackspeed

Join the community!
Want to report a bug or talk with fellow players about the game and the new features? You are invited to join our official disccord.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.1.1
notes.content:

 Rebalanced and decreased enemie spawn rates, this should make the overall game experience more enjoyable and less frustrating and give a higher change to reach the endgame mode

Join the community on discord and get involved! 

We wish you a lot of fun with this new patch!

notes.title: Patch 1.1.0.1
notes.content:
Here are the patch notes for the patch 1.1.0.1 adressing balancing changes for higher levels as well as bugfixes.

Balancing:


 Tier 9 enemies (Flying Cookie, Cookie Jar) do now spawn already after level 26 with a very low spawn rate. This should make the difficulty progression more steady.
 Tier 9 enemy spawn rate after level 28 has been decreased slightly. This should even out the difficulty jump towards endgame.


Bugfixes:


 The spawn patterns for the Banana Boss has been adjusted to prevent bananas spawning directly on the spaceship position. 
 The season countdown has now been fixed to display the right remaining hours, minutes and seconds.
 Fixed the death counter. Your deaths should now be properly tracked in the steam statistics 


We wish you a lot of fun with the new update.

notes.title: Transformation Update
notes.content:
We are excited to bring Cookie Invaders with Patch 1.1.0.0 to the next level. This is what the newest addition to Cookie Invaders will bring to you:

[previewyoutube=k4EaZFRDsoU;full][/previewyoutube]

New Features


 Added the Transformator which can be accessed in the evolution screen. You can now spend your conversion points to craft new modules, convert existing modules into new ones or to re-roll the stats on your current module.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34850485/8f070abf5ad4e3c1a4d9eca4f6463b6ac30ecebc.gif

 Conversion points are now obtained each 10 levels. This means you can now use them directly at level 10 to reshape your evolution tree. This brings reshaping the evolution tree into the early game and opens up much more possibilities for creating and adjusting your build to your current run.

 Cookie Invaders now has steam achievements. A total of 34 steam achievements have been added.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34850485/6de6c7e7b49fcaad6f16131ededd56370273aceb.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34850485/741835a88382d71410882df194360ae8a70f99aa.jpg {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34850485/4f21a1145b6d9b49a22914bde0d181377f4a4108.jpg 

 New stats window added to the main menu where you can view your game statistics.

 Added two new modules:

Barrier 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34850485/88291e4b8781a89e95ab48fb5cf18c8bb7150bf4.png 
Build a protecting barrier around your ship which destroys projectiles on collision.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34850485/49cb56b05b9770595beda07fe53caddb9e47a93a.gif

Charge
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34850485/983eb098a951b013262f1f6d37a0def800838bf7.png
Module can be dispatched multiple times.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34850485/8540e1c601243712180a77e04c0a1da13626436f.gif

 Added 5 new spaceship parts to the spaceship design pool.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34850485/7302be245a44d1a4fa6f718a9613247f432d0c2d.png


Game


 Added a tutorial for the Transformator
 Various smaller bugfixes


Tech

Performance improvements

We wish you a lot of fun with the new update.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2.1
notes.content:
Here are patch notes for the patch 1.0.2.1 addressing balancing on high levels.

Balancing:


 Changes to the enemy spawn algorithm for the level range of 26 - 30. This should now result in overall less high-tier enemies beeing spawned at those levels and smoothen out the tansition to the endgame.


Tech:


 Updates to the new rendering system.


We wish you a lot of fun with the new update.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2.0
notes.content:
We have been working for a long time on this update and are happy to release a huge update for cookie invaders. This is what Patch 1.0.2.0. will bring to you:

New Features


 Cookie Invaders has now full controller support for all common controller models. Simply connect your controller and move the left stick/ dpad to switch to controller input. 

 Added a new module which grants you the unique ability "burst". 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34850485/dcf28c8eb3062035979c989747bb4c623788e88e.gif

Your projectiles now burst on enemy contact which also deals damage to surrounding enemies. As all of those module abilities they can be combined with the skill tree modifiers for devastating build combinations.

 Added new artworks for all modules which grant unique abilities to make it easy to understand which module grants which ability.

Split Shot
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34850485/bc4e7027645675688c8e40f0ca35a52f76db64d7.png
Firefly
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34850485/ac5956db325c5aeee252d50d39d57328e87c8fcf.png
Burst
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34850485/501142fc6be1b2068f25d31be50fbe49d594865e.png
Sun Orb
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34850485/dfaacf8610cb7ddec46bc03dbffb8eceefab8d0a.png

Game


 Updated keybindings in the options menu to include controller key bindings
 Added tutorials for controller input
 Renamed "module destruction damage" to "module dispatch damage" for improved description
 Various smaller bugfixes


Tech

Moved to a new render pipeline

We wish you a lot of fun with the new update.

notes.title: New Year Update
notes.content:
To celebrate the turn of the year, we have prepared a sparkling update! This is what Patch 1.0.1.0. will bring to you:

New Features

Added two new Modules which grant you unique Abilities: 

Split Shot

Your Projectiles split into new projectiles on each enemy hit

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34850485/6fd769f8db523008b1547d1ecbc0273afd1297bb.gif

Sun Orb

Gain the power of devastating sun orbs which orbit around you

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34850485/27844bed877571e08fc9056a51d56de9f9304bd1.gif

There are many possibilities to combine the module abilities with the evolution skills. Have fun exploring the combinations!

Eternal Realm:


 Each wave does now contain 5 enemies instead of 3 to even out the difficulty range between the different waves


Visuals:


 Updated particle effects for the shaman master skill


Tech:


 Updated following scheme for aiming projectiles
 

Sound:


 Added one new boss fight soundtrack


We wish you a happy new year!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.21
notes.content:

New Features:

- Your current level is now displayed to your friends on the steam friendlist in realtime

Visuals:

Balance changes:

Planet Boss

Ritualist

Fury

Ferocity

Overload 
Attack Speed -70% (was -50%)

Rogue
Attack Speed 15% (was 10%)

Charged Shot 
Energy Regeneration +3 (was +2)

Charged Salve
Attack Speed 15% (was 10%)

Assassine

notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.20
notes.content:
We are constantly working on the game balancing. Here are the patch notes for Season 1 Week 3. Old values are written in brackets.

General Bugfixes:
- Improved scrollbars for highscore lists and seasonal ranking
- Fixed a bug which lead to received damage on item destroy when near to enemies
- Fixed a bug which lead to wrong calculated life regeneration rates after item destroy
- Fixed collision detection for Radiance and Supernova
- Various smaller bugfixes

Balance changes

General

- Increased the gained experience for bosses in the endgame
- Reduced the health of helicopter cookies
- Reduced the health and movement speed of the planet cookie boss

Skills

Rogue
- Attack Speed +10% (5%)
- Energy +10

Charged Fire
- Attack Speed +15% (10%)
- Energy Regeneration +1 (2)

Charged Shot
- Attack Speed +20% (5%)
- Energy Regeneration +2 (1)

Charged Salve
- Attack Speed +10%
- Energy Regeneration +2 (1)

Charged Blast
- Attack Speed +25% (20%)
- Energy Regeneration +3 (2)

Tank
- Life +500
- Melee Damage +5 (10)
- You can't fire Projectiles

Haste
- Melee Damage +3
- Attack Speed +10% (5)

Rush
- Melee Damage +5
- Attack Speed +10% (5)

Supernova
- Supernova now deals 20% of your life as area damage over 2 seconds (25%), supernova now drains 20% of your life (was 15%)

Radiance
- Radiance now deals 175% (was 150%) of melee damage per second

We wish everyone a lot of fun in Season 1 Week 3.
